Visited Singapore several times, and did things that visitors and tourists do, in our ex-pat centric area.

Stay at UE Square and walk to Seiyu supermarket in time to buy discounted sushi.

Walk to Clake Quay

We had to go local.

Went to 2005 Singapore Japanese Film Festival

<https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Japanese_Film_Festival>

A samurai completely befuddles opponents by calm nature, almost ready to die.

Seeing this the opponent drops their sword, feeling they are in the presence of a master

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Wondered how many job interviews I have attended, completely unaware of the scope of the position and my readiness or fit.

How many positions opened up to me because I had that "I am lost but content look"

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Subway guide

Whether I have that "I am Lost Also" or not I am not sure.

But locals have come up to me asking for direction.

I am not local and I don't know.

But I must have that, I am content look
